name: Crazy Party [RPG]
desc:
Crazy Party RPG is an oldschool Roblox RPG, where you grind to get stronger weapons and progress through the game.

Venture through different areas, defeat enemies, discover secrets and collect gear varying from weapons, to healing items and pets. This game has a lot of content, be it hidden or optional. Rare drops are not mandatory, but are of great help for the game's progression, can you get all of them?

[Playing in a private server is hugely recommended.]
